source: the audio-quality-run artifact of Nightly run 38415278161 on main, 2026-10-13: row chromium-aac-44100-bursty-plain (ubuntu-24.04-arm, headless Chromium, shaper seed 7), its --capture arrivals
description: This harness's AAC publisher through the shaper's bursty profile. Each seven-frame PES flush is one group per frame, delivered newest first, so most frames arrive after a newer one and the oldest of a flush is the latest. Recorded before the observer subscribed with the decoder's 2 s budget, so the groups that arrived later than the target then were never captured and replay as missing audio.
